title: Add HTML rendering helpers to rust_panic_service
description: Brownfield Rust task: add a pub mod html inside src/lib.rs with safe HTML-rendering wrappers over the panicking functions.

All 5 existing tests must still pass. pub fn render_divide(a: f64, b: f64) -> String — if b == 0.0: returns division by zero — otherwise: returns {value} where value = a/b pub fn render_find_user(users: &[&str], name: &str) -> String — if found at index i: returns

required_artifacts: pub mod html with render_divide, render_find_user, render_user_list
render_divide returns error span for b=0
render_divide returns result span for valid inputs
render_find_user returns li with index when found
render_find_user returns error li when not found
render_user_list returns empty-state for empty slice

followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `cargo test` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
